Retrieve the evidence tables for a set of Schedule N filings

Source: R/evidence.R
get_evidence_tables.Rd

Downloads (or reuses cached) evidence tables for the years around the filings, then reads only the rows for the donors and recipients involved and only the columns in evidence_tables(). The EIN filter and column projection are pushed into the parquet scan.

Usage

get_evidence_tables(
  fl,
  years = NULL,
  which = names(evidence_tables()),
  path = "PANEL990",
  source = panel990::data_source(),
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

fl

Filing table from sn_filings().

years

Tax years to read. Default: one year before the earliest filing to one year after the latest.

which

Names of evidence_tables() to retrieve.

path, source, verbose

Passed to panel990::download_tables().

...

Further arguments to panel990::download_tables().

Value

A named list of data.tables (one per element of which).

Details

These tables are large (Schedule O is about 150 MB per year, Part VII about 100 MB), so the first run downloads several hundred MB per year; later runs reuse the cache at path.
